summary: Autohome Inc. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits announcing its upcoming annual general meeting (AGM) and first-quarter 2026 financial results. The AGM will be held on June 23, 2026, in Beijing; shareholders of record as of May 27, 2026 are entitled to vote. The filing includes audited financial statements and standard proxy materials. No event-driven special situation is present—this is a routine regulatory filing covering periodic meeting and earnings disclosures. The filing does not involve any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital event.
